The 19 mismatches are first-fight logs alone: one value, a damage or its debug line, rounds to a different last printed digit, since Go's amd64 compiler does not fuse the multiply and add steps its arm64 compiler fuses and Rust follows with mul_add.

Production Forever sims run only on the arm64 Mac, the only poller of the Forever queue, where every golden matches. The amd64 PC worker image bundles the engine but does not poll that queue; if it did, its Go results would agree with Rust within tolerance but not exactly.
